summary: Frontend GCash flow tested end-to-end. Backend (per prior curl) confirmed working. Seller GCash setup UI, GCash payment page (name/number/QR image/ref submit), /orders GCash link states, and Seller Confirm Payment all PASS. HOWEVER a CRITICAL race-condition bug in Checkout.jsx breaks post-checkout navigation for BOTH gcash AND cod: after a successful /api/checkout POST the app navigates to /market instead of the intended /gcash-pay/{orderId} (or /orders for COD). The order IS created on the backend (200 OK) but the user is bounced back to the market, making the UI GCash payment flow unusable via the normal path.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful /api/checkout the client navigates to /market instead of /gcash-pay/{orderId} (or /orders for COD). Root cause: submit() calls clear() before navigate(), which triggers the useEffect on line 27 whose `items` dependency sees items.length===0 and force-navigates to /market, overriding the just-scheduled navigate(). Observed NAV sequence: 'NAV: /gcash-pay/<id>' then 'NAV: /market'. Affects BOTH gcash and cod paths (COD regression vs iteration_3).

integration_issues.flow: Buyer GCash checkout -> GCash payment page
integration_issues.issue: Order created (backend 200) but frontend never reaches /gcash-pay/{orderId}. Buyer would only see order under /orders and could manually click the 'Complete GCash payment' link to eventually pay.

issues: React warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent (a11y warning, non-blocking)

action_items: FIX Checkout.jsx submit(): call `navigate(...)` BEFORE `clear()`, OR add a submission/short-circuit guard in the useEffect on line 27 (e.g. `if (submitting) return;` before the items.length===0 redirect, or store 'placed=true' via useRef). This unblocks BOTH gcash and cod checkout navigation.
After fixing, re-run: place gcash order -> verify auto-nav to /gcash-pay/{orderId}; place cod order -> verify auto-nav to /orders.
(Minor) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to GCash settings DialogContent to silence the a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.jsx L27 useEffect uses `items` as a dependency and redirects to /market on empty cart. Since submit() calls clear() before navigate(), the effect fires post-clear and clobbers the intended navigation. Reorder to navigate-first-then-clear, or gate the empty-cart redirect with a submitting/placed flag.

GcashPayment.jsx looks solid — properly gates on auth loading, handles 404 -> /orders, uses fileUrl(qr_url) with fallback to server-generated /api/gcash-qr/{id}. Verified QR PNG (490x490) loads correctly.
SellerDashboard GCash dialog handles create + persistence correctly (verified via reopen).

context_for_next_testing_agent: GCash feature: backend is fully functional (verified). GCash payment page (/gcash-pay/:orderId), seller GCash settings dialog, /orders GCash link, and seller verify-payment button all WORK correctly when reached. The ONLY blocking bug is Checkout.jsx post-submit navigation: place-order (gcash OR cod) navigates the buyer to /market instead of the intended destination because clear() before navigate() triggers the empty-cart redirect useEffect. To reproduce: buyer login, add-to-cart, /checkout, fill address+phone, pick gcash (or cod), click place-order -> URL ends at /market despite backend creating the order successfully. After fix, retest: (1) gcash place-order -> auto-nav to /gcash-pay/{id} with visible gcash-pay-page + gcash-name/gcash-number/gcash-qr-img/gcash-ref-input, (2) cod place-order -> auto-nav to /orders. Note: NAV events captured via response listener show 'NAV: /gcash-pay/{id}' immediately followed by 'NAV: /market' confirming the race.
